questions.q: The ozone hole is most pronounced over which region?
questions.exp: Extremely cold stratospheric clouds over Antarctica enable rapid ozone destruction in spring.

questions.q: Excess exposure to UV-B radiation reaching the Earth's surface due to ozone depletion can cause
questions.exp: UV-B damages DNA and the lens of the eye.

questions.q: El Niño is characterised by
options: Warming of the Arctic Ocean only
Abnormal warming of surface water in the central and eastern Pacific Ocean
questions.exp: El Niño often weakens the Indian summer monsoon.

questions.q: Which of the following contributes to sea-level rise due to global warming?
options: Thermal expansion of sea water and melting of land ice
Melting of floating sea ice only
questions.exp: Warmer water expands and melting glaciers/ice sheets add water to oceans.

questions.q: The population of a town is 20000 and grows 10% every year. What will it be after 2 years?
A trader buys 40 kg of rice at Rs 25/kg and 60 kg at Rs 30/kg, mixes them and sells the whole at Rs 32/kg. What is his total profit?
What is the measure of each interior angle of a regular octagon?
The product of two numbers is 2160 and their HCF is 12. What is their LCM?
questions.exp: HCF x LCM = product, so LCM = 2160/12 = 180.

questions.q: Five students scored 45, 60, 52, 48 and 70 marks. What is the mean score?
In a certain code, LILY is written as NKNA. How is ROSE written?
questions.exp: Each letter is shifted +2 (L→N, I→K, L→N, Y→A with wrap-around). So R→T, O→Q, S→U, E→G, giving TQUG.

questions.q: Find the next term: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, 37, ?
questions.exp: The terms are n² + 1: 1²+1 = 2, ..., 6²+1 = 37, so the next is 7²+1 = 50.

questions.q: Fish : Shoal :: Sheep : ?
questions.exp: A group of fish is a shoal and a group of sheep is a flock.

questions.q: Which of the following is the odd one out?
questions.exp: Triangle, square and circle are two-dimensional figures; a cube is three-dimensional.

questions.q: Pointing to a photograph, a man said, 'I have no brother or sister, but that man's father is my father's son.' Whose photograph was it?
questions.exp: The man has no brother, so 'my father's son' is the man himself. Hence the person in the photograph is his son.
